privacySummary: The Bridge works only with folders Deanne explicitly chooses.
Watching is read-only until Deanne approves an Organization Plan and types EXECUTE.
NSN does not upload Deanne's full local library.
Disconnecting a folder does not delete local files.
Folder access can be revoked at any time.
releaseNotes: Unsigned development release for internal testing on Deanne's MacBook.
macOS may block the first launch until Deanne chooses Open Anyway in Privacy & Security.
Production Bridge architecture for macOS pairing, folder selection, command polling, and safe execution authorization.
Installer assets are published through GitHub Releases or GitHub Actions artifacts, not committed into the repository.
